remarks: Experience a truly unique rental opportunity with this converted commercial space offering an exceptional blend of style, function, and versatility. The ground level features 9-foot garage doors and newly installed epoxy floors, creating a clean, polished environment that works equally well as additional living space, a studio, or the perfect home for a luxury vehicle. This level also includes a convenient half bath and laundry hookups for added practicality. Upstairs, you'll find a brand-new residential space with beautiful hardwood floors, and newly installed appliances. The layout includes a spacious bedroom, generous closets, and abundant storage throughout the unit-plus an attic area for even more flexibility. Perfect for those seeking something beyond the typical rental, this one-bedroom unit delivers style, convenience, and exceptional space in a truly one-of-a-kind setting.
